托育人员学习与练习册 · 2026-10-15 · 编辑改进版

Version 0.2 — editorial revision; current legal-source verification incomplete.

These books support general child-care staff practice. All 50 editions reuse the same 1,000 exercises in 100 situation families, with ten guided tasks per family. They do not represent 50,000 independent cases or verified state-law answers.

Current federal and state source verification is incomplete. Use this edition for provisional practice, not as verified state-law guidance. No agency approval, training credit, or validated exam is claimed. Legal research exercises are unscored.

本版是语言与教学改进稿，现行官方资料尚未成功读取，法律审核未完成。50州共用100个情境系列、1,000个练习，不是50,000个独立或已核实法律案例。不代表政府批准，不授予培训学时，不是经验证的正式考试。查规则练习不计分。

Learn first, then practice

Read the short teaching note. Explain your response before revealing the suggested answer. Then try the demonstration with fictional facts. Keep real children, names, health details and family records out of practice materials.

先读教学提示，再自行回答，最后看建议答案。演示使用虚构资料，不放入真实儿童、健康或家庭信息。

CA-0001 · CORE-0001 · FAM-001 · center · EDITORIAL DRAFT

Doorway handoff — First safe action

门口交接 — 先做什么

Teaching note / 学习提示

Say, “Maya, you have Leo now.” Maya replies, “I have Leo.” Both check Leo against the attendance list.

说清儿童姓名，请接手成人明确回应，再按当日名单核对。交接完成前，原照护者继续负责。

Situation / 情境

A child moves through a connecting doorway while both adults believe the other is supervising. You are handling this situation while children are in care.

儿童穿过相连房间的门，两位成人都以为对方在监管。你处理这个情况时，仍有儿童在园。

Try it / 先回答

For “Doorway handoff”: State a practical first action. Explain how children remain supervised while it is done.

针对“门口交接”：说出可行的第一步，并说明怎样保持儿童有人照看。

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

Say, “Maya, you have Leo now.” Maya replies, “I have Leo.” Both check Leo against the attendance list. Keep children supervised while addressing the issue; do not let paperwork delay an urgent safety response.

说清儿童姓名，请接手成人明确回应，再按当日名单核对。交接完成前，原照护者继续负责。 处理时保持儿童有人照看；紧急安全行动不能等文书完成。

Why it matters / 为什么

An adult nearby may not know that responsibility has changed.

附近有成人，不代表对方知道自己已经接手照看。

Demonstrate / 演示练习

Use fictional facts to explain or demonstrate the response to “Doorway handoff”. Name the concern, show a feasible action and explain why it helps. Do not create the actual hazard.

用虚构资料说明或演示“门口交接”的处理：指出问题、展示可行行动并解释原因。不制造真实危险。

Applicability and local rule check / 适用范围与规则核实

Check the exact license category; center/home are practice settings, not legal classifications.

须核实准确许可类别；中心和家庭只是练习场景，不是完整法律分类。

Find and verify supervision, transitions, and attendance procedures for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed.

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证监管、活动转换与出勤程序。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。

Source leads, not verified citations: HEADSTART_SUPERVISION, CCDF. See source catalog. State rule verified: no. Independent bilingual review: pending. Assessment: formative practice; not a validated exam.

CA-0002 · CORE-0002 · FAM-001 · home · EDITORIAL DRAFT

Doorway handoff — Working alone

门口交接 — 独自工作

Teaching note / 学习提示

Say, “Maya, you have Leo now.” Maya replies, “I have Leo.” Both check Leo against the attendance list.

说清儿童姓名，请接手成人明确回应，再按当日名单核对。交接完成前，原照护者继续负责。

Situation / 情境

A child moves through a connecting doorway while both adults believe the other is supervising. You operate a family child-care home and are the only qualified caregiver on site.

儿童穿过相连房间的门，两位成人都以为对方在监管。你经营家庭托育，现场只有你一位合格照护者。

Try it / 先回答

For “Doorway handoff”: You are the only qualified caregiver on site. What can you do now, and what must wait or use an approved backup plan?

针对“门口交接”：现场只有你一位合格照护者。现在能做什么，什么需要推迟或采用获准备用方案？

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

Stay responsible for the child while the handoff is incomplete. If no eligible adult is actually available, do not send the child through the doorway alone. Keep children with you in a permitted, safely supervised area and use the approved contingency plan if safe care cannot continue.

交接未完成前，继续负责照看。没有合格成人接手时，不让儿童独自穿过门口。让儿童留在允许且能安全照看的区域；不能持续安全照护时，采用获准应变方案。

Why it matters / 为什么

An adult nearby may not know that responsibility has changed.

附近有成人，不代表对方知道自己已经接手照看。

Demonstrate / 演示练习

Use fictional facts to explain or demonstrate the response to “Doorway handoff”. Name the concern, show a feasible action and explain why it helps. Do not create the actual hazard.

用虚构资料说明或演示“门口交接”的处理：指出问题、展示可行行动并解释原因。不制造真实危险。

Applicability and local rule check / 适用范围与规则核实

Check the exact license category; center/home are practice settings, not legal classifications.

须核实准确许可类别；中心和家庭只是练习场景，不是完整法律分类。

Find and verify supervision, transitions, and attendance procedures for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed.

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证监管、活动转换与出勤程序。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。

Situation / 情境

A child moves through a connecting doorway while both adults believe the other is supervising. Someone asks you to skip a safety or verification step because it would be more convenient.

儿童穿过相连房间的门，两位成人都以为对方在监管。有人为图方便，要求省略安全或核实步骤。

Try it / 先回答

For “Doorway handoff”: Someone asks you to skip a step. What will you explain, and what safe alternative will you offer?

针对“门口交接”：有人要求省略一个步骤。你怎样解释，并提供什么安全替代安排？

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

Say, “Maya, you have Leo now.” Maya replies, “I have Leo.” Both check Leo against the attendance list. Explain the concern in plain language: An adult nearby may not know that responsibility has changed. Offer the safe option described above, or pause the proposed activity while a permitted alternative is confirmed. Do not promise an exception you have not verified.

说清儿童姓名，请接手成人明确回应，再按当日名单核对。交接完成前，原照护者继续负责。 用简单话解释原因：附近有成人，不代表对方知道自己已经接手照看。 提供上述安全做法，或在核实允许的替代安排前暂停拟议活动。不承诺未核实的例外。

Doorway handoff — Handoff

门口交接 — 交接

Teaching note / 学习提示

Say, “Maya, you have Leo now.” Maya replies, “I have Leo.” Both check Leo against the attendance list.

说清儿童姓名，请接手成人明确回应，再按当日名单核对。交接完成前，原照护者继续负责。

Situation / 情境

A child moves through a connecting doorway while both adults believe the other is supervising. A qualified substitute will take over later and needs a specific briefing.

儿童穿过相连房间的门，两位成人都以为对方在监管。合格代班人员稍后接手，需要了解具体情况。

Try it / 先回答

For “Doorway handoff”: A qualified substitute will take over later. What facts, actions and unresolved points must you explain before the handoff?

针对“门口交接”：合格代班人员稍后接手。交接前，要说清哪些事实、行动和未解决事项？

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

Say, “Maya, you have Leo now.” Maya replies, “I have Leo.” Both check Leo against the attendance list. Tell the substitute what was observed, what has been done, and what remains unresolved. Have them explain the next action in this particular situation before you transfer responsibility. Check role eligibility separately.

说清儿童姓名，请接手成人明确回应，再按当日名单核对。交接完成前，原照护者继续负责。 说清看到了什么、已做什么、还未解决什么；请代班人员复述本情境的下一步。实际交接前另行核实职责资格。

CA-0005 · CORE-0005 · FAM-001 · center · EDITORIAL DRAFT

Doorway handoff — Uncertain records

门口交接 — 记录不明确

Teaching note / 学习提示

Say, “Maya, you have Leo now.” Maya replies, “I have Leo.” Both check Leo against the attendance list.

说清儿童姓名，请接手成人明确回应，再按当日名单核对。交接完成前，原照护者继续负责。

Situation / 情境

A child moves through a connecting doorway while both adults believe the other is supervising. The available record and a verbal account do not clearly agree.

儿童穿过相连房间的门，两位成人都以为对方在监管。现有记录和口头说法不完全一致。

Try it / 先回答

For “Doorway handoff”: The record says the issue is resolved, but you cannot confirm it. What facts will you check and record without guessing?

针对“门口交接”：记录说问题已解决，但你无法确认。你应核对和记录什么，怎样避免猜测？

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

Say, “Maya, you have Leo now.” Maya replies, “I have Leo.” Both check Leo against the attendance list. Separate direct observations, another person's account and unknown facts. Preserve the original entry and add a dated correction or clarification through the record process. Do not postpone urgent care or an already-required report to make the accounts agree.

说清儿童姓名，请接手成人明确回应，再按当日名单核对。交接完成前，原照护者继续负责。 区分亲眼观察、他人转述和未知事实。保留原记录，按程序注明实际日期作更正或补充。不能为了统一说法拖延紧急照护或已经要求的报告。

Doorway handoff — An offer of help

门口交接 — 有人帮忙

Teaching note / 学习提示

Say, “Maya, you have Leo now.” Maya replies, “I have Leo.” Both check Leo against the attendance list.

说清儿童姓名，请接手成人明确回应，再按当日名单核对。交接完成前，原照护者继续负责。

Situation / 情境

A child moves through a connecting doorway while both adults believe the other is supervising. Someone offers practical help, but their permitted role has not been checked.

儿童穿过相连房间的门，两位成人都以为对方在监管。有人愿意帮忙，但其允许承担的职责尚未核实。

Try it / 先回答

For “Doorway handoff”: A helper has not been approved for child-care duties. What help could you consider without handing over supervision or private records?

针对“门口交接”：帮手尚未获准承担照护职责。你可考虑什么协助，同时不把看护或私人资料交给对方？

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

Say, “Maya, you have Leo now.” Maya replies, “I have Leo.” Both check Leo against the attendance list. Keep child-care responsibility yourself unless an eligible person has formally accepted it. Consider only help allowed for that person, such as an approved non-care task that does not expose private information. Do not treat willingness as clearance or training.

说清儿童姓名，请接手成人明确回应，再按当日名单核对。交接完成前，原照护者继续负责。 没有合格人员正式接手时，你继续负责看护。只安排该人获准承担的工作，例如不涉及儿童照护和隐私的适当杂务。热心不等于完成审查或培训。

Doorway handoff — Prevent a repeat

门口交接 — 防止重演

The total head count looks right, but the roster includes a child who left earlier. An authorized reviewer asks for the facts and the evidence supporting your response.

总人数看似正确，但名单仍包括早已离园的儿童。获授权的审阅人员要求了解事实和支持处理结果的资料。

Try it / 先回答

For “Outdoor return”: What truthful explanation and supporting record would show what you did, what worked and what is still unknown?

针对“户外返回”：你会怎样如实说明做了什么、哪些有效、哪些仍未知，并提供什么记录？

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

Check each child's name and face against today's arrivals and departures. Ten children on the list and ten in the room do not prove they are the same ten. Give the actual timeline, action, result and remaining uncertainty. Use accurate records relevant to this event. Do not backdate a checklist, invent a fact, or imply that an explanation proves legal compliance.

按今天的到离园记录，逐一把儿童姓名与本人对应。不要只数总人数。 如实说明时间、行动、结果和未知情况，提供本事件相关记录。不倒签、不编造，也不把解释得好当成已证明合法合规。

Why it matters / 为什么

A correct total can hide the wrong child or an outdated list.

人数正确，也可能名单过时或少了某个儿童。

卫生捷径 — 说明处理经过

Teaching note / 学习提示

After toileting help, complete the required handwashing steps before preparing food. Wearing gloves does not remove the need for hand hygiene.

协助如厕后，按正确步骤洗手，再接触食物；同时保持儿童有人照看。

Situation / 情境

An adult moves from toileting assistance to food preparation without completing hygiene steps. An authorized reviewer asks for the facts and the evidence supporting your response.

成人协助如厕后，未完成卫生步骤便准备食品。获授权的审阅人员要求了解事实和支持处理结果的资料。

Try it / 先回答

For “Hygiene shortcut”: What truthful explanation and supporting record would show what you did, what worked and what is still unknown?

针对“卫生捷径”：你会怎样如实说明做了什么、哪些有效、哪些仍未知，并提供什么记录？

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

After toileting help, complete the required handwashing steps before preparing food. Wearing gloves does not remove the need for hand hygiene. Give the actual timeline, action, result and remaining uncertainty. Use accurate records relevant to this event. Do not backdate a checklist, invent a fact, or imply that an explanation proves legal compliance.

协助如厕后，按正确步骤洗手，再接触食物；同时保持儿童有人照看。 如实说明时间、行动、结果和未知情况，提供本事件相关记录。不倒签、不编造，也不把解释得好当成已证明合法合规。

Why it matters / 为什么

Gloves do not replace the required hand hygiene steps.

戴手套不能代替必要的手部清洁。

Demonstrate / 演示练习

Use fictional facts to explain or demonstrate the response to “Hygiene shortcut”. Name the concern, show a feasible action and explain why it helps. Do not create the actual hazard.

用虚构资料说明或演示“卫生捷径”的处理：指出问题、展示可行行动并解释原因。不制造真实危险。

Applicability and local rule check / 适用范围与规则核实

Check the exact license category; center/home are practice settings, not legal classifications.

须核实准确许可类别；中心和家庭只是练习场景，不是完整法律分类。

Find and verify hand hygiene, diapering, toileting, and sanitation for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed.

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证手部卫生、换尿布、如厕与消毒规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。

Source leads, not verified citations: CDC_DIAPER, CDC_HANDS. See source catalog. State rule verified: no. Independent bilingual review: pending. Assessment: formative practice; not a validated exam.

Teaching note / 学习提示

Do not turn a diapering area into a food surface just by wiping it. Check permitted uses and follow the correct treatment steps for that surface.

Situation / 情境

A surface used for personal care is repurposed without checking sanitation and permitted uses. You are handling this situation while children are in care.

个人照护表面未经核查消毒与用途就改作他用。你处理这个情况时，仍有儿童在园。

Try it / 先回答

For “Shared care surface”: State a practical first action. Explain how children remain supervised while it is done.

针对“共用照护表面”：说出可行的第一步，并说明怎样保持儿童有人照看。

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

Do not turn a diapering area into a food surface just by wiping it. Check permitted uses and follow the correct treatment steps for that surface. Keep children supervised while addressing the issue; do not let paperwork delay an urgent safety response.

Cleaning a surface does not automatically make every use permitted.

清洁过的台面，不代表可以改作任何用途。

Use fictional facts to explain or demonstrate the response to “Shared care surface”. Name the concern, show a feasible action and explain why it helps. Do not create the actual hazard.

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证手部卫生、换尿布、如厕与消毒规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。

Shared care surface — Talk with a family

Teaching note / 学习提示

Do not turn a diapering area into a food surface just by wiping it. Check permitted uses and follow the correct treatment steps for that surface.

不要以为擦一下换尿布区域就能备餐。先核实允许用途和正确清洁处理步骤。

Situation / 情境

A surface used for personal care is repurposed without checking sanitation and permitted uses. The affected family asks for an explanation of what happened.

个人照护表面未经核查消毒与用途就改作他用。受影响家庭询问发生了什么。

Try it / 先回答

For “Shared care surface”: What verified information about this situation can you explain to the affected family, and what must remain private or unresolved?

针对“共用照护表面”：你可向受影响家庭说明什么已知事实，哪些隐私或未知情况需要保留？

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

Do not turn a diapering area into a food surface just by wiping it. Check permitted uses and follow the correct treatment steps for that surface. 混合化学品 — 向家庭说明

Teaching note / 学习提示

Do not mix cleaning products. If products were mixed, keep children away and follow the exposure and emergency procedure; do not try another chemical to cancel the mixture.

不要混合清洁产品。如已混合，让儿童远离并按接触或应急流程处理，不再加别的化学品。

Situation / 情境

Someone proposes mixing cleaning products to make them stronger. The affected family asks for an explanation of what happened.

有人提议混合清洁产品来增强效果。受影响家庭询问发生了什么。

Try it / 先回答

For “Chemical mixing”: What verified information about this situation can you explain to the affected family, and what must remain private or unresolved?

针对“混合化学品”：你可向受影响家庭说明什么已知事实，哪些隐私或未知情况需要保留？

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

Do not mix cleaning products. If products were mixed, keep children away and follow the exposure and emergency procedure; do not try another chemical to cancel the mixture. Explain the verified facts affecting that family's child and the action actually taken. Say openly what is not yet known. Restrict unrelated private details, while fulfilling any separately applicable notice or reporting duty.

不要混合清洁产品。如已混合，让儿童远离并按接触或应急流程处理，不再加别的化学品。 说明与该家庭儿童有关的已核实事实和实际行动，坦诚指出未知情况。限制无关隐私，同时履行另行适用的通知或报告义务。

Why it matters / 为什么

Mixing products can create hazards that separate product use does not.

混合产品，可能产生单独使用时没有的危险。

Demonstrate / 演示练习

Use fictional facts to explain or demonstrate the response to “Chemical mixing”. Name the concern, show a feasible action and explain why it helps. Do not create the actual hazard.

用虚构资料说明或演示“混合化学品”的处理：指出问题、展示可行行动并解释原因。不制造真实危险。

Check the exact license category; center/home are practice settings, not legal classifications.

须核实准确许可类别；中心和家庭只是练习场景，不是完整法律分类。

Delayed incident notice — Prevent a repeat

事故通知延误 — 防止重演

Teaching note / 学习提示

Identify each required recipient and deadline from the applicable rule. A call to the parent does not automatically satisfy a licensing or protective-reporting duty.

分别确认家庭、许可机构、保护机构或卫生部门等适用通知对象和时限，不以一次电话代替全部要求。

Situation / 情境

An incident was addressed, but notification responsibilities were never assigned. A similar problem has returned after an earlier reminder.

事故已处理，但没有指定通知责任。此前提醒过，但类似问题再次出现。

Try it / 先回答

For “Delayed incident notice”: What practical change would reduce a repeat, and how could you check it without putting a child at risk?

针对“事故通知延误”：什么实际改进可减少重演？怎样检查效果而不让儿童冒险？

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

Identify each required recipient and deadline from the applicable rule. A call to the parent does not automatically satisfy a licensing or protective-reporting duty. 内部审批障碍 — 记录不明确

Teaching note / 学习提示

Do not wait for the owner's approval when your reporting duty is triggered. Make the required report through the official route and follow internal notice steps without delaying it.

已经触发个人报告义务时，不等老板批准；按官方渠道报告，内部通知不得造成拖延。

Situation / 情境

A worker believes a reportable concern must wait for the owner's permission. The available record and a verbal account do not clearly agree.

员工认为须等业主许可，才能报告可能需报告的担忧。现有记录和口头说法不完全一致。

Try it / 先回答

For “Internal approval barrier”: The record says the issue is resolved, but you cannot confirm it. What facts will you check and record without guessing?

针对“内部审批障碍”：记录说问题已解决，但你无法确认。你应核对和记录什么，怎样避免猜测？

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

Do not wait for the owner's approval when your reporting duty is triggered. Make the required report through the official route and follow internal notice steps without delaying it. Separate direct observations, another person's account and unknown facts. Preserve the original entry and add a dated correction or clarification through the record process. Do not postpone urgent care or an already-required report to make the accounts agree.

已经触发个人报告义务时，不等老板批准；按官方渠道报告，内部通知不得造成拖延。 区分亲眼观察、他人转述和未知事实。保留原记录，按程序注明实际日期作更正或补充。不能为了统一说法拖延紧急照护或已经要求的报告。

Why it matters / 为什么

Internal permission cannot substitute for an individual's triggered reporting duty.

内部许可，不能代替已经触发的个人报告义务。

Demonstrate / 演示练习

Use fictional facts to explain or demonstrate the response to “Internal approval barrier”. Name the concern, show a feasible action and explain why it helps. Do not create the actual hazard.

用虚构资料说明或演示“内部审批障碍”的处理：指出问题、展示可行行动并解释原因。不制造真实危险。

Applicability and local rule check / 适用范围与规则核实

Check the exact license category; center/home are practice settings, not legal classifications.

须核实准确许可类别；中心和家庭只是练习场景，不是完整法律分类。

Find and verify mandated reporting, confidentiality, and protective action for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed.

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证强制报告、保密与保护行动规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。

Source leads, not verified citations: NY_REPORT, CCDF. See source catalog. State rule verified: no. Independent bilingual review: pending. Assessment: formative practice; not a validated exam.

The legal answer is unresolved in this edition. Identify the state and local jurisdiction, exact license or registration category, relevant ages and roles, and any program participation. 先保护安全，再减少拥挤、调整过渡安排，提供足够成人支持，而不只责怪儿童。

Situation / 情境

Two children repeatedly clash during a crowded transition. You operate a family child-care home and are the only qualified caregiver on site.

两名儿童在拥挤转换活动时反复冲突。你经营家庭托育，现场只有你一位合格照护者。

Try it / 先回答

For “Escalating conflict”: You are the only qualified caregiver on site. What can you do now, and what must wait or use an approved backup plan?

针对“冲突升级”：现场只有你一位合格照护者。现在能做什么，什么需要推迟或采用获准备用方案？

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

Separate children safely when needed. Reduce crowding by sending a small group to wash hands while the others do a short activity with adequate supervision. Keep the children supervised. Delay non-urgent competing tasks. Use a backup caregiver only if their role is permitted and their eligibility is confirmed; if safe care cannot continue, use the applicable contingency plan.

先保护安全，再减少拥挤、调整过渡安排，提供足够成人支持，而不只责怪儿童。 继续照看儿童，推迟不紧急的冲突任务。只有核实职责和资格后才能用备用照护者；不能安全继续时，按适用应变方案处理。

Why it matters / 为什么

Crowding and rushed transitions can contribute to repeated conflict.

拥挤和匆忙转换活动，可能让冲突反复发生。

Check the exact license category; center/home are practice settings, not legal classifications.

须核实准确许可类别；中心和家庭只是练习场景，不是完整法律分类。

Escalating conflict — Find the local rule

冲突升级 — 查当地规则

Teaching note / 学习提示

Separate children safely when needed. Reduce crowding by sending a small group to wash hands while the others do a short activity with adequate supervision.

先保护安全，再减少拥挤、调整过渡安排，提供足够成人支持，而不只责怪儿童。

Situation / 情境

Two children repeatedly clash during a crowded transition. A saved summary may be outdated or may concern a different license category.

两名儿童在拥挤转换活动时反复冲突。保存的摘要可能过时，也可能针对其他许可类别。

Try it / 先回答

For “Escalating conflict”: What exact program, license category and current source must be identified before answering the legal part of this situation?

针对“冲突升级”：回答本情境的法律问题前，要先确认什么项目、许可类别和现行来源？

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

The legal answer is unresolved in this edition. Identify the state and local jurisdiction, exact license or registration category, relevant ages and roles, and any program participation. 立即开除请求 — 先做什么

Teaching note / 学习提示

Address the immediate safety concern, then review individual supports, family input, and the rules that apply to this program before deciding on enrollment.

先处理安全，再审查支持措施、家庭意见、反歧视义务和入园决定流程，不直接一律开除。

Situation / 情境

Someone wants to end enrollment without reviewing supports or the written process. You are handling this situation while children are in care.

有人不审查支持措施或书面流程，就想终止入园。你处理这个情况时，仍有儿童在园。

Try it / 先回答

For “Immediate expulsion request”: State a practical first action. Explain how children remain supervised while it is done.

针对“立即开除请求”：说出可行的第一步，并说明怎样保持儿童有人照看。

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

Address the immediate safety concern, then review individual supports, family input, and the rules that apply to this program before deciding on enrollment. Keep children supervised while addressing the issue; do not let paperwork delay an urgent safety response.

先处理安全，再审查支持措施、家庭意见、反歧视义务和入园决定流程，不直接一律开除。 处理时保持儿童有人照看；紧急安全行动不能等文书完成。

Why it matters / 为什么

An enrollment decision needs individual facts and applicable program rules.

是否继续入园，需要结合个人情况和适用项目规则。

Demonstrate / 演示练习

Use fictional facts to explain or demonstrate the response to “Immediate expulsion request”. Name the concern, show a feasible action and explain why it helps. Do not create the actual hazard.

用虚构资料说明或演示“立即开除请求”的处理：指出问题、展示可行行动并解释原因。不制造真实危险。

Applicability and local rule check / 适用范围与规则核实

Check the exact license category; center/home are practice settings, not legal classifications.

须核实准确许可类别；中心和家庭只是练习场景，不是完整法律分类。

Find and verify reasonable modifications, expulsion, notice, and nondiscrimination for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed.

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证合理调整、开除、通知与反歧视规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。

Source leads, not verified citations: ADA_CHILDCARE, IDEA, HEADSTART. See source catalog. State rule verified: no. Independent bilingual review: pending. Assessment: formative practice; not a validated exam.

In immediate danger, use the appropriate emergency response now. / 遇到即时危险，立即采用相应应急行动。

Situation / 情境

Someone wants to end enrollment without reviewing supports or the written process. You operate a family child-care home and are the only qualified caregiver on site.

有人不审查支持措施或书面流程，就想终止入园。你经营家庭托育，现场只有你一位合格照护者。

Try it / 先回答

For “Immediate expulsion request”: You are the only qualified caregiver on site. What can you do now, and what must wait or use an approved backup plan?

Address the immediate safety concern, then review individual supports, family input, and the rules that apply to this program before deciding on enrollment. Keep the children supervised. Immediate expulsion request — Prevent a repeat

立即开除请求 — 防止重演

Teaching note / 学习提示

Address the immediate safety concern, then review individual supports, family input, and the rules that apply to this program before deciding on enrollment.

先处理安全，再审查支持措施、家庭意见、反歧视义务和入园决定流程，不直接一律开除。

Situation / 情境

Someone wants to end enrollment without reviewing supports or the written process. A similar problem has returned after an earlier reminder.

有人不审查支持措施或书面流程，就想终止入园。此前提醒过，但类似问题再次出现。

Try it / 先回答

For “Immediate expulsion request”: What practical change would reduce a repeat, and how could you check it without putting a child at risk?

针对“立即开除请求”：什么实际改进可减少重演？怎样检查效果而不让儿童冒险？

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

Address the immediate safety concern, then review individual supports, family input, and the rules that apply to this program before deciding on enrollment. Before a worker takes over, give them the child's necessary care instructions and have them explain what they will do. Keep unrelated private details restricted. 整改缺少证明 — 防止重演

Teaching note / 学习提示

If a latch was repaired, test that it closes and secures properly during normal use. Keep the repair evidence and required submission; an invoice alone does not prove the hazard is fixed.

在日常使用中测试整改是否有效，例如检查门闩能否可靠关好，并保留所需证明。

Situation / 情境

A cited problem is marked corrected without checking whether the fix works. A similar problem has returned after an earlier reminder.

未检查修复是否有效，就把问题标为已整改。此前提醒过，但类似问题再次出现。

Try it / 先回答

For “Correction without proof”: What practical change would reduce a repeat, and how could you check it without putting a child at risk?

针对“整改缺少证明”：什么实际改进可减少重演？怎样检查效果而不让儿童冒险？

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

If a latch was repaired, test that it closes and secures properly during normal use. Keep the repair evidence and required submission; an invoice alone does not prove the hazard is fixed. Turn this action into a checkable routine: name the responsible person and confirm that the relevant safeguard works during safe ordinary use or a simulation. Do not recreate a hazard with a child to test the change.

在日常使用中测试整改是否有效，例如检查门闩能否可靠关好，并保留所需证明。 把这一做法变成可检查的日常步骤，明确负责人，在安全日常使用或模拟中确认有效。不让儿童再次处于危险来检验整改。

Why it matters / 为什么

A repair invoice does not establish that the repaired safeguard works.

有维修账单，不代表安全装置真的有效。

Demonstrate / 演示练习

Use fictional facts to explain or demonstrate the response to “Correction without proof”. Name the concern, show a feasible action and explain why it helps. Do not create the actual hazard.

用虚构资料说明或演示“整改缺少证明”的处理：指出问题、展示可行行动并解释原因。不制造真实危险。

Applicability and local rule check / 适用范围与规则核实

Check the exact license category; center/home are practice settings, not legal classifications.

须核实准确许可类别；中心和家庭只是练习场景，不是完整法律分类。

Find and verify license category, changes, inspections, corrections, and appeals for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed.

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证许可类别、变更、检查、整改与申诉规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。

Source leads, not verified citations: CCDF. See source catalog. State rule verified: no. Independent bilingual review: pending. Assessment: formative practice; not a validated exam.

Try it / 先回答

Keep the repair evidence and required submission; an invoice alone does not prove the hazard is fixed.

Inspection access confusion — Uncertain records

检查访问不明 — 记录不明确

Teaching note / 学习提示

Follow the official identity-check procedure promptly and arrange lawful access. Do not invent a manager-only rule that blocks an authorized inspection.

及时按官方方法核实检查员并提供合法访问，不自行设定必须经理在场才可检查。

Situation / 情境

Staff are unsure how to verify an inspector and provide authorized access. The available record and a verbal account do not clearly agree.

员工不确定如何核实检查员并提供获准访问。现有记录和口头说法不完全一致。

Try it / 先回答

For “Inspection access confusion”: The record says the issue is resolved, but you cannot confirm it. What facts will you check and record without guessing?

针对“检查访问不明”：记录说问题已解决，但你无法确认。你应核对和记录什么，怎样避免猜测？

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

Follow the official identity-check procedure promptly and arrange lawful access. Do not invent a manager-only rule that blocks an authorized inspection. Family communication barrier — Handoff

家长沟通障碍 — 交接

Teaching note / 学习提示

Use short sentences, pictures, or appropriate language support. Ask, “Can you tell me the pickup plan in your own words?” so unclear instructions can be fixed.

用短句、图片或合适语言支持，请家庭用自己的话说出安排，以便发现并修正不清楚之处。

Situation / 情境

Important instructions are given in a form the family cannot understand. A qualified substitute will take over later and needs a specific briefing.

重要说明采用家庭无法理解的形式。合格代班人员稍后接手，需要了解具体情况。

Try it / 先回答

For “Family communication barrier”: A qualified substitute will take over later. What facts, actions and unresolved points must you explain before the handoff?

针对“家长沟通障碍”：合格代班人员稍后接手。交接前，要说清哪些事实、行动和未解决事项？

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

Use short sentences, pictures, or appropriate language support. Ask, “Can you tell me the pickup plan in your own words?” so unclear instructions can be fixed. Tell the substitute what was observed, what has been done, and what remains unresolved. Have them explain the next action in this particular situation before you transfer responsibility. Check role eligibility separately.

用短句、图片或合适语言支持，请家庭用自己的话说出安排，以便发现并修正不清楚之处。 说清看到了什么、已做什么、还未解决什么；请代班人员复述本情境的下一步。实际交接前另行核实职责资格。

Why it matters / 为什么

A message is useful only when the recipient can understand and use it.

信息只有对方能理解、能使用，才真正有效。

Demonstrate / 演示练习

Use fictional facts to explain or demonstrate the response to “Family communication barrier”. Name the concern, show a feasible action and explain why it helps. Do not create the actual hazard.

用虚构资料说明或演示“家长沟通障碍”的处理：指出问题、展示可行行动并解释原因。不制造真实危险。

Find and verify program planning, family communication, meals, rest, and individual needs for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed.

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证课程规划、家园沟通、用餐、休息与个人需求规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。

For “Rule update rumor”: What truthful explanation and supporting record would show what you did, what worked and what is still unknown?

针对“规则更新传闻”：你会怎样如实说明做了什么、哪些有效、哪些仍未知，并提供什么记录？

Suggested answer and explanation / 建议答案与解释

A practical response / 可行处理

Find the issuing authority's effective text and check its date and scope before changing practice. Keep the social media post as a lead, not as the rule. Give the actual timeline, action, result and remaining uncertainty. Use accurate records relevant to this event. Do not backdate a checklist, invent a fact, or imply that an explanation proves legal compliance.

找到签发机构的现行文本，查日期、适用范围和例外后再改做法，并安排后续更新检查。 如实说明时间、行动、结果和未知情况，提供本事件相关记录。不倒签、不编造，也不把解释得好当成已证明合法合规。

Why it matters / 为什么

A social-media claim is a lead, not proof of an effective rule.

社交媒体消息只是线索，不是规则已生效的证明。

Demonstrate / 演示练习

Use fictional facts to explain or demonstrate the response to “Rule update rumor”. Name the concern, show a feasible action and explain why it helps. Do not create the actual hazard.

用虚构资料说明或演示“规则更新传闻”的处理：指出问题、展示可行行动并解释原因。不制造真实危险。

Applicability and local rule check / 适用范围与规则核实

Check the exact license category; center/home are practice settings, not legal classifications.

须核实准确许可类别；中心和家庭只是练习场景，不是完整法律分类。

Find and verify policy maintenance, accountability, record integrity, and rule updates for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed.

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证政策维护、责任、记录诚信与规则更新规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。

Source leads, not verified citations: CCDF. See source catalog. State rule verified: no. Independent bilingual review: pending. Assessment: formative practice; not a validated exam.

In immediate danger, use the appropriate emergency response now. / 遇到即时危险，立即采用相应应急行动。
